Read SOA (Area Definition) File

Source: R/read_soa.R
read_soa.Rd

This function parses SAAM .soa files. These files define "Areas," which are named collections of airports.

Structure: Each line defines one Area:

  • Field 1: Area Name (Must be >= 5 chars).

  • Field 2..N: Members (Airports or other previously defined Area names).

Features:

  • Recursion: An Area can contain other sub-Areas (e.g., "Paris" contains "Roissy").

  • Wildcards: Airport names may contain . as a wildcard (e.g., ED..).

Usage

read_soa(soa_file, resolve_recursion = FALSE)

Arguments

soa_file

Path to the .soa file.

resolve_recursion

Logical. If TRUE, the function attempts to fully expand sub-areas into their constituent airports. Defaults to FALSE (returns raw hierarchy).

Value

A data.table with the following columns:

  • area_id: The name of the defined Area.

  • member_id: The identifier of the member (Airport or Sub-Area).

  • is_wildcard: Logical. TRUE if the member ID contains wildcards (.).

Details

Reads a .soa file defining sets of airports (Areas) for segment management rules.
